entries.291b1525174556b2: A holding company that operates an investment and consulting business supporting M&A, business succession and business turnaround, and a drug discovery support business that creates genetically modified mice and undertakes contract testing.
entries.5a5845e4af121d88: A business that promotes new businesses through M&A, centered on its subsidiary TG Business Service Co., Ltd., and provides advisory and support services in business succession and business turnaround. Operating companies under it also engage in retail and wholesale of electrical appliances, import and sale of Western tableware and e-commerce, and development and sale of information and communications equipment. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥10,921 million, accounting for about 83% of consolidated revenue.

entries.69e6ee219b310f8f: This business provides seamless services covering every stage of drug discovery, from exploratory basic research and drug discovery research in the early stages through to non-clinical and clinical trials. It undertakes contract production of genetically modified mice, contract antibody production, contract sugar chain analysis and synthesis, and contract non-clinical and clinical trials, including pharmacological efficacy and safety testing of pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals and food-related substances. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,252 million.
